stops.name: Monte Marsicano
stops.detail: The highest peaks are the Grande mountain (Mount Argatone, which reaches 2149 m a.s.l.), the Serra della Terratta, Mount Godi and Mount Marsicano, which reaches 2245 m a.s.l..

stops.name: Lago di Barrea
stops.detail: In Barrea, a dam generates the lake of Barrea with its waters.

days.title: Karst Phenomena and Waterfalls
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Macchiarvana
stops.detail: It develops between Pescasseroli, Alvito and Campoli Appennino, characterized by the presence of evident karst phenomena such as sinkhole fields (Macchiarvana, La Difesa), swallow holes, caves and underground watercourses surfacing for short stretches (Capo d'Acqua in Campoli Appennino).

stops.name: Cascata di Acqua Ventilata
stops.detail: Caves and swallow holes are found in the locality of Cicerana (Lecce nei Marsi), while the Acqua Ventilata waterfall is located in the municipality of Gioia dei Marsi.

days.title: Lazio and Molise Borderlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Monte Petroso
stops.detail: The highest peaks are Mount Petroso (2247 m a.s.l.) and Mount Meta (2242 m a.s.l.) located on the border between the Lazio, Molise and Abruzzo sides.

stops.name: Lago Vivo
stops.detail: In the park area there are some interesting natural lakes such as Lake Vivo, which is seasonal, Lake Pantaniello, whose state reserve—important for its high altitude and fish presence—falls among the peaks of Mount Godi, and Lake Scanno, created following a landslide in the Sagittario river valley, near Villalago and at the foot of the town of Frattura in the municipal territory of Scanno.
